groups.rationale: Reviewed chapter 22's host responsibilities and generated deployment view: salopettes is added as a Susan-only hcloud host with no fleet authority, and its loss boundary (delayed, retried and expiring pokes) is stated; system domains and other hosts are unchanged.

Reviewed the regenerated deployment topology, coverage and new hcloud-susan-host scenario: chapter 22 now places Susan on salopettes behind nginx ACME TLS for the unchanged compiled origin, so Marshall's Notifications egress and retry behaviour are documented against a real placement; no Marshall code changed.
Reviewed the shared chapter 19 and 22 changes: they add the hcloud host platform and salopettes Susan placement; no protocol module, wire format or SusanPoke contract changed.
Reviewed the shared chapter 19 and 22 changes: hcloud hosts refuse Lilly and the Hetzner and EC2 guest storage, KVM and budget paths are unchanged, so Lilly behaviour and evidence are unaffected.

Reviewed Susan placement: chapter 22 replaces the open hosting text with salopettes, nginx ACME HTTP-01 TLS, loopback port 4100, no access logs and fleet-updater deployment per ADR-0231; Susan's service module and protocol are unchanged.

Reviewed the hcloud platform (host tool validate/discover/guard/storage, profile single-disk zroot/root, no KVM or Lilly) and the salopettes host declaration and Susan-only role; chapter 13 documents --platform hcloud, chapter 22 adds the salopettes row, assertions, generated view and Susan placement, and the hcloud-susan-host scenario records the unit and evaluation evidence.

Reviewed ADR-0231 (hcloud platform and Susan placement), the ADR-0224 open-question resolution, the ADR-0043 related link, the index row and the host-provisioning hcloud section; chapters 13, 19 and 22 carry the matching handbook text and scenario.
